headline: Google DeepMind reports an Antigravity workflow for cheminformatics and macrocycle design
summary: Google DeepMind's 3 November walkthrough describes a human-steered Antigravity workflow for cheminformatics using a lung-cancer-treatment example. The company reports literature and catalog search across thousands of compounds, a curated view of 568 compounds, matched-pair analysis, potency models and proposed rigidified macrocycles with synthesis routes in about an hour. The report is first-party evidence of what Google describes, not independent confirmation of the run or its measurements. The source says the designs are hypotheses that require synthesis and experimental validation; it reports no such validation.
